dedupe_keys.name: elmod transmission grid load flow model

description: ELMOD – Transmission Grid load flow model is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Technische Universität Dresden. The power grid model ELMOD focuses on the optimal management of grid congestion and operation in the European electricity transmission system. Coverage: Germany, United Kingdom, Ukraine. Methodical focus: Linear Optimisation Model. Time resolution: hour. Spatial resolution: Transmission grid nodes. Software: GAMS. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
